people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
translations.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.”
translations.kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
translations.asv: Peter saith unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee even now? I will lay down my life for thee.
